entities.summary: Gomirje Monastery is a Serbian Orthodox monastery in Croatia. It is the westernmost Serb Orthodox monastery, located in the western part of Croatia near the village of Gomirje, near the town of Ogulin. The monastery is thought to have been founded in 1600. The monastery includes the church of Roždenije saint John the Baptist, built in 1719. Gomirje Monastery is a monastery in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
